description: *Amended March 12th I am writing today with an update regarding the affordable housing project at 27-29 Hancock Street in Beacon Hill. The BPDA has announced a public meeting for the project on March 26th, 2025 at 6 - 7:30pm. This will be an opportunity for the community to give input on Fenway CDC
title: 27-29 Hancock Street Update — Jay Livingstone State Rep.
